engine_facts_summary: SWarp reads the CD matrix and ignores PC/CDELT when CD is present; it applies TPV; a .head must be CD-only (astropy misreads TPV with both forms)
the output coadd.head alone pins the grid
MAP_WEIGHT + RESCALE_WEIGHTS N uses the maps as given; RESCALE_WEIGHTS Y silently re-derives them; FLXSCALE f divides a map's weight by f^2
BACK_DEFAULT per-image lists are subtracted; seqstat full carries IKSS location/scale per channel, so Siril's addscale can be re-created (the NONE coadds land on the reference's own sky to +0.05 %)
SWarp reads only the first plane of a 3-plane FITS (per-channel split needed)
a two-member 23-Mpx-each coadd onto the 48-Mpx canonical grid takes 2-3 s per channel
